scope: Public official records and licensed nonofficial corpora relevant to institutional accountability; not an ethics score or partner contract.
rule: Source acquisition, custody, legal-entity resolution, evidence review, publication and third-party reuse are separate states.

sources.returns: Awards, spending, recipient identifiers, obligations or amounts only where endpoint defines them
sources.limits: Award Amount field is source-native, distinct from ceilings, actual payments, revenues or accepted systems.
sources.license: US government public records; API/software/data rights to be separately confirmed.

sources.returns: Contract actions, purchase orders, IDVs and detailed contract structures
sources.limits: Revealed DoD data has a 90-day delay. Account/API key required. No restricted/unrevealed access.
sources.license: Official government API; terms and download limits require review.

sources.limits: Opportunity is not a signed contract or an obligation; only latest active notice version in API.

sources.returns: Submission history, XBRL, filed Form D where exact filer IDs resolved
sources.limits: A filing does not prove latest beneficial ownership, fund allocation or advisory/control rights. SEC fair-access limits apply.
sources.license: US government public filing data; third-party exhibits may have separate rights.

sources.returns: Committees, disbursement itemizations, official filing images
sources.limits: FEC donor lists have restrictions on commercial solicitation; do not repurpose personal donor data into a people search.
sources.license: Official FEC data with explicit acceptable-use restrictions.

sources.returns: Award IDs, amount, agency, company UEI, program phases
sources.limits: Official API is under maintenance as of 2026-11-02; download has fuller fields. Awarded R&D is not operational field acceptance.

sources.returns: Congressional, regulatory and governmental primary documents
sources.limits: Source text is context, not proof of influence or an individual decision.
sources.license: Government documents; individual referenced exhibits need rights checking.

sources.returns: EIN-linked nonprofit filings and finance summaries
sources.limits: Small filers and religious organizations may lack Form 990; does not prove every source of funds.
sources.license: Data/source rights and ProPublica API terms to verify before public redistribution.

sources.returns: Source-native offshore entities and typed relations
sources.limits: Names/relationships are source reported and frequently historical, not allegations or current beneficial ownership; source data not uniformly current.
sources.license: ODbL (database), CC BY-SA (contents); attribution and share-alike obligations.

sources.returns: Restricted and designated entity data; matching candidates
sources.limits: Commercial reuse of the compiled dataset requires license; entity matching candidates are not confirmed identities.
sources.license: Compiled database CC BY-NC 4.0, separate software licenses.

sources.returns: 2026 dated company roster and ranking context
sources.limits: A ranking is context and never a qualifying hop or proof of a procurement relationship.
sources.license: Publisher's content terms; keep limited source citations.

interchanges.name: FollowTheMoney
interchanges.limits: Data package and underlying source licenses remain separate. Stub emits no unverified ownership or amount semantics.

interchanges.name: nomenklatura
interchanges.limits: Only consider once source-native recipient ids and entity resolution have a validated path.

interchanges.name: Open Contracting Data Standard
interchanges.limits: Do not call an award-only projection a complete OCDS contract or payment record.

interchanges.name: Aleph
interchanges.limits: Avoid copying an entire indexing stack until an actual reviewer requires more than Clifford's current index.

publication.not_included: No new graph joins, sanctions flags, person scores, raw source distributions or confidential data.
